verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs describe the FinancialAccount as a container separate from the Payments balance, and they define Transactions as the ledger entries for financial accounts. Platforms can surface those entries through activity feeds, the Dashboard, and an embeddable Treasury disclosure component. That covers only part of the ledger-visibility and disclosure side of the story, with nothing plainly documenting pooling or insurance. Missing for 10: any documentation of FBO/pooled vs individually titled accounts, where FDIC insurance attaches (partner banks, pass-through coverage), explicit ledger access/visibility roles, and independent corroboration that the structure is explained plainly.
